headline: NOBEL 🏆💦 PENETRATES Anne Carson's oeuVRAVE 🍑📜
text:
‼️WAKE UP all you clasSICK 🍆💦 LIT SLUTS 📖😩‼️ Canadian poet 🇨🇦 Anne Carson 📜 just got 🥵 her 7️⃣6️⃣ year old 🧓 oeuvre absolutely 💦 RAILED 🥵🍆 by the Nobel 🏆 committee for her BOLD 😏 and INVENTIVE 🧠 boundary CROSSING 🍑🕳️ that penetrates the clasSICK tradition 😩📜 in playful 😜 dialogue until it BIRTHS 🍼💦 brand new FORMS for contemporary 📚 literature ‼️ She joked 😂 the judges ⚖️ were all CRAZY 🤪 for honouring 🏅 her while 🌬️ listening to the ICELANDIC 🇮🇸 wind 🌬️🍑 in a voice 🗣️ dripping with surprise 😲 and HAPPY 🥰 moans 😳 The Swedish Academy 🇸🇪 said her lyriCUM 📖💦 poetry breaks 🔓 free from narrative 📖 self to get 🔁 transLICKtions of Greek 🇬🇷 works TWISTED 🌀 and STRETCHED 🕳️ into comic 😂 graphic novels 🖼️ and tango 💃 essays that make 👵 ancient beauties 🏛️ like Helen 🏛️ and Marilyn 💋 get it on in performance 🎭 pieces 🕺💦 Her 1️⃣2️⃣ million Swedish 🇸🇪 kronor prize 🏆 is the ultimate 💦 lifetime LOAD 💰🍆 after 3️⃣0️⃣ years professing 👩‍🏫 classics and collaborating 🤝 with choreographers 🕺 to demonstrate 📣 total freedom 🕊️ with literary 📜 rule systems 🍑📏
